name: Audit trail
summary: Every action the agent takes, and every permission decision behind it, is written to an append-only log that people can review later. It doesn't prevent anything on its own; it makes mistakes and abuse traceable after the fact.
how: Record each tool call with inputs, result, time and acting identity
Record who or what approved it
Store the log outside the agent's reach
facts: WorkOS Airlock audits every decision; AP2 chains signed mandates into an audit trail; Stripe Workbench logs MCP tool calls
Cheap to add, but only detects after the fact
watchOut: Logs can capture secrets or personal data
A log nobody reads catches nothing
